title: 5.2.2 Swinging Pendulum — Worked Example
description: A rod hangs from a fixed anchor using a HingeJoint. Click to give it a push.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: A static anchor and a dynamic rod, joined by a HingeJoint — that makes them rotate around the anchor.
hints: The hinge position is set by the anchor's position; the rod just hangs off it.

steps.title: Longer rod
steps.instructions: Change the rod's height from 120 to 220. It swings more slowly because its moment of inertia grew.

steps.title: Chain two pendulums
steps.instructions: Add a second rod hinged to the first rod's bottom end. You just built a double pendulum.
hints: new HingeJoint(rod, rod2) — the second rod hangs from the first.
